faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support - II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Technical Support - II position at AIIMS Delhi is 19th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have completed 12th grade with a Science stream and a Diploma in MLT/DMLT with 5 years of experience, or a BSc in Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Medical Lab Technology, or Bioinformatics with 2 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support - II role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Technical Support - II position is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 20,000 per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as admissible.

faq.question: Q5. Is this a permanent or temporary job?
faq.answer: The job for Project Technical Support - II at AIIMS Delhi is on a temporary basis.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support - II recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the provided Google Form link before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the AIIMS Delhi located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Delhi is located in New Delhi, Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Delhi apply for this post?
faq.answer: The notification mentions inviting applications from eligible candidates in Delhi, suggesting a preference or requirement for local candidates.
